summary: Icy Veins S2 rebuild: 18 tier moves, 3 forecast moves, 0 consensus. Archon tank survivability re-cut. Aug-18 tuning post edits folded in. WCL rdps broken, 3 raw keys landed.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 181-329 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = the tier letter; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally): raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. UPSTREAM REBUILT: 18 tier moves against stored (11 raid, 7 M+), the largest being Subtlety Rogue raid B->S, Assassination Rogue C->A+ and Balance Druid S->A, with Subtlety's M+ cell placed at A+ after reading TBD last night. The parse was cross-checked tier by tier before merging (S 3 / A+ 6 / A 5 / B 11 / C 2 = 27 raid DPS), so this is a real re-cut and not a parser artifact. Era read from each page's own title AND body: five titles self-identify as Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and the raid-HEALER page again carries a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a Season-2 body (changelog "13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch after the first few live tests", prose "for Midnight Season 2") - body over title, per the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and NO seasonVerified value changed this run, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to freeze. Because liveSeason is still s1, these letters stay OUT of the consensus (the frozen lane holds Icy Veins' final S1 letters) and feed only the 12.1 forecast, which is why 18 tier moves produced 0 consensus moves and 3 projection moves. published re-read per page, never carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-16 (stored said 08-08), raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16 (stored said 08-08) - agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 189-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way this era-gated source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)", never Season 1. 39 rated rows + 1 explicit null: Subtlety Rogue is upstream TBD on the DPS page and is written as null rather than omitted or guessed (26 DPS placed + 7 healer + 6 tank). ZERO tier moves against stored - the list is unchanged since its 2026-08-09 rebuild, which matches its weekly Sunday cadence. published re-read from the page (JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09; the in-body "Last UPDATED" line still says 08-02 and dateModified wins) and unchanged, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence. Snapshots 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. The M+ page carries 8 tier blocks, not 4 - the extra S/A/B/C set is the dungeon-difficulty list, rejected by ROSTER MATCH (the eight dungeon names and the site logo simply fail to map) rather than by position. Era from each page's own body: raid "how each spec ranks for Raiding content in the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" (Last Updated 10th August 2026), M+ "how different specs rank ... in Midnight Season 2" (Last Updated 13th August 2026). seasonVerified stays s2 on both; nothing to freeze. Method carries no published field by convention and none was invented. Snapshots 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-336 KB. Parsed by unescaping \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], never by anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( (the raid-healer page carries a 1.2 KB decoy call), with tolerant whitespace on [tier-label ...]X [/tier-label] and the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug as the identifier: 27/7/6 raid + 27/7/6 M+ = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Era: all six headlines read "for Midnight Season 2"; seasonVerified stays s2, nothing to freeze, and like Icy Veins these letters feed the forecast rather than the consensus while liveSeason is s1. published re-read per page: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 08-17 (was 08-16), raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS 08-15, M+ healer 08-17 (was 08-16), M+ tank 08-17 (was 08-11) - agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. Snapshots 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 63-98 KB, parsed from the <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> JSON (WebFetch markdown drops it) at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, taking metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+ - never the default popularity grouping - and resolving every entry from its icon "Class-Spec" token, never the display name ("BeastMastery Hunter" / "DemonHunter-Devourer"), with tiers[].entries read as a list OF LISTS. 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Archon's own lastUpdated reads 2026-08-17T12:00:00Z and its zone headers are still zone-46/zone-47 (Imperator ... Midnight Falls, the Season 1 raid), so seasonVerified stays s1: Archon remains the only source feeding the live consensus in its own right. Snapshots 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

Full 51-page re-fetch (9 raid bosses + 8 M+ dungeons x 3 roles), 51/51 HTTP 200, same __NEXT_DATA__ + icon-token parse as the aggregate pages, and the committed encounter `name` values were preserved rather than taken from page.title. 619 tier rows written (was 678): every one of the 619 retained rows is IDENTICAL to stored - 0 tier moves, 0 gains - and the 59 difference is Archon withholding thin cuts now that Season 1 is dead content. Proven upstream, not a parse failure: on those same pages the survivability tierList still returns 27/7/6 while throughput returns 0, and the pages carry Archon's own "Not a lot of data matches your filters" warning at 24-45 parses. Crown lost all three roles (172/45/24 parses), Chimaerus kept DPS only, Vanguard lost tanks. That is 8.7% of rows, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25 and well above the 440 floor. asOf advanced 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-17 (Archon's own lastUpdated, not the run date).

Read from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages (the same __NEXT_DATA__ payload that carries throughput and popularity), 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched. Archon RE-CUT the tank list: Blood Death Knight, Brewmaster Monk and Vengeance Demon Hunter B->A and Protection Paladin C->A, leaving Protection Warrior alone in S at 95.8% against a 88.2-90.7% A band - the published percentages back the new grouping. DPS and healer survivability letters are unchanged. Note the honest oddity: the specRankings numbers on those same pages are byte-identical to stored, so this is a threshold re-cut rather than new parses. spec.survivability.asOf advanced 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-17 (Archon's lastUpdated); page snapshot 2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-18.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-parsed in full from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] - NOT the tierList structure, which carries no numbers - on the raid DPS and raid tank pages: 33 rows (27 DPS + 6 tank), floats rounded to match the stored integer precision, each row's `parses` carried as n. Every one of the 33 values AND its n is byte-identical to stored, so nothing was merged and asOf stays at Archon's own 2026-08-16 rather than being restamped with today. Deliberately NOT merged: the raid-HEALER page also exposes a `dps` column (7 healer rows, e.g. Holy Paladin 10440), which would silently grow this 33-row series to 40 and change what it measures - healers belong to archon-hps. Season 1 raid logging has effectively stopped since 12.1 shipped (4903 total parses over the 14-day window), which is the honest reason a rolling aggregate has not moved in two days.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)", 7/7 healer rows from the raid-healer page's specRankingsSection table (hps column, floats rounded, parses carried as n; 1286 parses over the window). All 7 values and counts byte-identical to stored, so nothing merged and asOf stays 2026-08-16 - the same Season-1-is-over freeze as archon-metrics, reported per requirement rather than coupled to it.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-parsed in full from the three M+ pages (HTTP 200; 1.39M/470k/471k parses in the window): 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, every value and n byte-identical to stored for the eighth consecutive day. Nothing merged; asOf stays at the source's own 2026-08-10. Season 1 keys stopped being played when 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so Archon's M+ cut is frozen even though its page label reads lastUpdated 2026-08-17 - stamping that label onto frozen values is exactly what the staleness gate exists to catch. Season 2 keys open with today's reset, so this should resolve on the next run or two.

80 rows parsed (raid + M+, all roles) and shape-checked BEFORE any merge: every value a plausible percentage (0.6-39.6), the six role x bracket groups summing to 100.1 / 100.0 / 99.9 / 99.8 / 100.0 / 100.0 (599.8 total), and no row equal to that spec's own "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" - the check that catches the DPS-column-under-a-%-unit failure. All 80 values are byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision, raid and M+ alike, so nothing was merged; the raid rows stay at 2026-08-16 and the M+ rows at 2026-08-10, and the requirement's coverage date (min-th-freshest across the family) correctly reads 2026-08-10.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers/proxy/auth (the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and must never be used). manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two agree, so unlike the 08-04 case there is no hidden movement behind a pinned manifest. Selected by WHITELIST (categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField === "lowerBound" + keyRange === undefined, never a "not dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 name-matched with no mapping table. All 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts identical to stored at 1 dp. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (7 days, inside the contract's 8-day threshold), never today. Upstream has not run a pipeline since the day 12.1 shipped.

All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB, 40/40 rows parsed by anchoring on the meta-item blocks - the parse is healthy and this is a DATA decision, not a failure. MERGE HELD BACK WHOLESALE for the third night: SEVEN specs read a literal 0 (Devastation Evoker, Marksmanship Hunter, Arcane Mage, Frost Death Knight, Protection Warrior, Protection Paladin, Vengeance Demon Hunter - verified in the raw HTML, they are ranked 24th/25th with a published 0, not a parse miss), and all 40 values moved, the median falling 4008 -> 3435. Those seven zeros are 100% value moves against maxValueMovePct 0.6, which has NO agent-writable proposal channel, and merging the other 33 alone would publish a mixed-date pool under one series name. The pages still title themselves "Midnight Season 1" while their body text describes Patch 12.1, and the ratings reset that Season 2 brings is exactly what the zeros and the falling ceilings are. Stored data left byte-identical at 2026-08-15. OWNER DECISION STILL NEEDED: re-base or pause "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" across the Season-2 boundary.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 3 retries each, and the 13 failures re-probed a fourth and fifth time by hand: 14 specs return real data, 13 return the 76-byte {"status": "error", "message": "No standard chart with these values found."} body persistently (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Assassination, Outlaw, Demonology, Arms, Fury). All 14 that DID return carry simc_settings.tier "MID2" (read off each chart, never hard-coded - it moves each season) with chart timestamps 2026-08-15 (12 specs) and 2026-08-18 (2 specs), while the 26 stored profiles are MID1-era. MERGED NOTHING, per the sim-tier uniformity gate: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so a 14-of-27 merge would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Adopt a new tier wholesale or not at all. fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHARTS' own 2026-07-08 / 07-15, 41 days stale, and the heartbeat goes red - which is the true signal that upstream has not finished re-simming for Season 2. simc_settings.ptr compared explicitly against the STRING "0".

Both transports fetched, HTTP 200. The plain-text MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block - its header reads SimulationCraft 1210-01 for 12.1.0.69382 Live (hotfix 2026-08-18/69382, git build HEAD 8a83cb502a), which has moved again from last night's 5039a0f382, so the Season-2 re-sim is still churning. Fell back to MID1_Raid.html per the recipe: it is UNCHANGED - SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git build 678e66d384). Re-parsed anyway by taking the "data":[...] array enclosing the FIRST big-value MID1_ hit (a fixed byte window after "series" reads the later burst/DTPS charts at 2.2-2.5x inflation) and mapping profile names by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed: 49 profiles -> 26 DPS specs, all 26 byte-identical to stored; the 9 unmapped names are tank profiles, excluded by design. Nothing merged; an unchanged build hash is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse. No MID2_Raid report exists yet (both .txt and .html 404).

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1075, HTTP 200 - the SAME period as the last four runs: "Period 1075, week 20 of MID1 (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Tyrannical, Fortified, Xal'atath's Guile)", 10000 characters / 2863 unique / 22.6 average key level. The weekly roll has not happened, and with Season 1 keys dead since 08-11 it may not. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon blocks) with lowercase-hyphenated labels normalised on [-\s]+: 34 rows, 0 unmatched. Verified it is the representation SHARE and not the /meta per-key-PRESENCE column before comparing - series sum 100.3%, max row 18.3. All 34 values identical to stored; the 6 roster specs absent from the chart are the same 6 stored at 0. Nothing merged; asOf stays 2026-08-14.

Four channels swept. (1) Dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest is Linxy #19 - already the feed's 07-31 entry; the thread has been quiet since the PTR cycle ended. (2) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block (items are <title> THEN <link>, never tag adjacency): 40 items, newest 2026-08-17 23:07 CDT. (3) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) because it leads RSS within a run. (4) Blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, newest 2026-08-17 20:55. CHANGE LANDED: Blizzard EDITED the "Class Tuning Incoming - August 18" post twice on 08-17 (topic 2336820, post updated_at 2026-08-18T01:51Z, read from the canonical forum JSON, not from the Wowhead mirror). Two lines were ADDED to the PvE CLASS CHANGES section - Retribution Paladin "All ability damage increased by 6%" (a NEW spec for that entry; it previously appeared only in the PvP section) and Discipline Priest "Void Shield reflects 10% of damage (was 15%)" - and the Frost DK line now reads "all ability and auto-attack damage". All three were folded into the existing 2026-08-15 feed entry (specsAffected 14 -> 15, highlights 14 -> 15) with the label amended to record the edits and to correct its now-false claim that Retribution Paladin appears only under PvP. Both new lines were verified against the forum post rather than the news article. NOT LOGGED, deliberately: the Kaivax "Hotfixes - August 17, 2026" round-up (Wowhead news=382492). Its class section is BUG FIXES ONLY with no throughput tuning - one functional Beast Mastery fix (Wildspeaker Dire Beast Kill Commands were not benefiting from four talents), a Holy Priest spec-swap fix, a Shaman spellbook display bug and a Destruction Warlock tooltip - which matches the precedent that left the 08-14 Kaivax hotfixes out of the feed. FLAG FOR THE OWNER: it also cannot currently be logged as the feed's newest entry even if wanted, because test/validate.test.mjs (the host-allowlist test) sets forumUrl on builds[0] and asserts exactly one error, which a kind:"hotfix" newest entry turns into two - a hotfix landing on the newest date reds `npm test`. Also swept and correctly not in the feed: "Mythic+ Dungeon Tuning with Season 2 Launch" and "Season 2 Dungeon Adjustments" (dungeon, not class) and the datamined Venomcursed / Ritual Stone item hotfixes. Writeup coverage recomputed rather than read: 1 spec at ptr:null (Demonology Warlock, a deliberate null), 0 specs without a raid-scoped expert read, 0 without an M+ one.

Discovery complete, distillation impossible - 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added, and no `latest` field advanced. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0, because data/pending-transcripts.json was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran (a local run drained the nine videos queued last night). No transcript was fetched from YouTube or any API by this agent, and nothing was installed or upgraded. 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff, 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries diffed against a 1092-id seen-set built from the four STRUCTURED lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never a regex over log prose. 33 unseen, all in-cycle against the 2026-06-18 bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, not builds[0]). FOUR QUEUED under the nightly's keyword filter and the fetch-broadly/queue-narrowly rule: izen okaZqAQVRN0 "Raid Specs Meta Predictions" (general creator -> metaNotes; its own chapter list is Tanks / Healers / DPS, and raid is the bracket with the least PTR evidence), Zorthas x0fxEWTq3Pw "Pre-Season Tuning Analysis & Tier List Update" (general creator, chapters Tuning Patch / Raid / Tier List Update), NeekapHere jlbQAmQMRCM "Retribution Paladin BUFFED - But We're Not Fixed Yet" (his registered spec, and tonight's tuning edit buffs exactly that spec) and Dratnos 6MlSd4nBtrI, whose description chapters include "Raid Comp Predictions" - unlike his 08-16 RWF-logistics video that was left unseen. NOTHING was retired to seen[]: no dismissal tonight is durable. The other 29 stay UNSEEN, counted rather than estimated: 12 guides/routes/gearing videos (including Shadarek's Devourer BiS guide and Tactyks' M+ tips, the latter also firewalled because he writes the Method M+ list), 10 stream or leveling shells, 4 PvP-framed uploads (Supatease x3 and a Dalaran Gaming duels video - his "Nine WORST Specs 12.1" cannot be told apart from a PvP read on the title alone, and the 08-09 precedent is that his season reads are PvP-reasoned), NeekapHere's "This Week In WoW" news round-up, Bansherz' two Twitch-shell uploads and YoDaTV's Twitch restream. media:description again settled most of the triage at zero transcript cost.
